headline: Will Estee Lauder Stock Ever Get Back To Its Old High?
summary: Estee Lauder Companies (EL) stock closed at its previous peak in January 2022, and the shares trade today at less than a third of that price. Many investors continue to evaluate their positions against that close, treating it as the natural baseline where the stock belongs and will eventually return. So what would getting back to the old high take.

headline: 3 Profitable Stocks We Think Twice About
summary: While profitability is essential, it doesn’t guarantee long-term success. Some companies that rest on their margins will lose ground as competition intensifies — as Jeff Bezos said, “Your margin is my opportunity”.
